authorities.title: Equity
supports: Florida mortgages are foreclosed in equity; mortgage foreclosure is a court proceeding rather than California-style nonjudicial trustee-sale procedure.

authorities.title: Elements of complaint; lost, destroyed, or stolen note affidavit
supports: Covered residential foreclosure complaints must contain specified allegations concerning plaintiff status and note enforcement, with additional requirements when the note is lost, destroyed, or stolen.

authorities.title: Power to set aside foreclosure decrees before sale
supports: Florida law recognizes judicial authority under the statute to set aside a foreclosure decree before the foreclosure sale; this is not an unconditional homeowner right to cancel a sale.

authorities.title: Order to show cause; entry of final judgment of foreclosure; payment during foreclosure
supports: A lienholder may request an order to show cause; the statute creates a distinct expedited hearing procedure with its own service and hearing conditions, separate from ordinary complaint response procedure.

mortgage_default_letter.label: I RECEIVED A MORTGAGE DEFAULT / ACCELERATION LETTER
mortgage_default_letter.description: Pre-suit mortgage default and acceleration requirements can depend on the loan documents, servicing law, and loan program. No generic Florida clock is inferred here.

foreclosure_complaint.label: I WAS SERVED WITH A FORECLOSURE COMPLAINT
foreclosure_complaint.description: Florida mortgage foreclosure is a judicial action. Complaint-content requirements are verified, but the ordinary response clock remains null until current civil-rule service and computation authority is fully traced.

order_to_show_cause.label: I RECEIVED AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE
order_to_show_cause.description: Section 702.10 creates a distinct show-cause procedure. It is not treated as identical to ordinary complaint response or summary judgment.

summary_judgment.label: A MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT WAS FILED
summary_judgment.description: Summary judgment is a separate litigation stage. No deadline is published until current Florida civil-rule timing is verified against the actual event and service method.

final_judgment.label: A FINAL JUDGMENT OF FORECLOSURE WAS ENTERED
final_judgment.description: Final judgment is distinct from judicial sale, certificate of sale, certificate of title, appeal, stay, and physical possession.

judicial_sale.label: A FORECLOSURE SALE IS SCHEDULED
judicial_sale.description: Judicial sale procedure requires separate Chapter 45/Chapter 702/civil-rule review. No sale, objection, title, or redemption clock is guessed.

post_sale.label: THE PROPERTY WAS SOLD / CERTIFICATE PROCEDURE IS PENDING
post_sale.description: Sale, certificate of sale, objections, certificate of title, redemption cutoff, and possession remain separate events pending primary-authority review.

post_sale_possession.label: I RECEIVED POSSESSION PAPERS AFTER FORECLOSURE
post_sale_possession.description: Former owner, tenant, bona fide tenant, and other occupant categories must be established before post-sale possession rules are rendered.

cross_dataset_refs.purpose: Post-foreclosure tenant routing and Florida PTFA route.
